# Section 7 — scenario results (generated by compare_sim.py)

Model results under stated assumptions, not observed improvements. 22 working days = 30.4 calendar days. Work durations are deterministic; waits and arrivals are stochastic. Each comparison uses 3 seeds unless a single-seed absence path is specified.
Lead/P90 are unavailable if offered workload exceeds capacity or the arrival cohort remains censored. Such cases have no defensible stationary lead estimate; completed-only diagnostics are not substituted. Capacity is analytical work-content capacity, not throughput.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 23.1 | 36.4 | 600 | 940 | 24 | 88% | 12% |
| v1 · standardize | 7.1 | 10.3 | 437 | 709 | 33 | 56% | 44% |
| v2 · AI scripting | 3.9 | 5.2 | 349 | 595 | 40 | 30% | 70% |
| v3 · single render | 1.6 | 2.1 | 61 | 182 | 230 | 8% | 92% |
